test_title: PYST 23: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Find the correct alternative that when filled in the blanks in the same sequence will make the series logically complete.

P _ S _ T _ P _ _ PT _ _T _ P _ S
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• PTSPTSSPT → P **P** S / **T** T **S** / P **P T** / P T **S / S** T **P /** P **T** S
 
• PPTSSTPST → P **P** S / **P** T **T** / P **S S /** P T **T / P **T
